changelog: Shipping updates by text message, off by default, through the shop's own account with Twilio, ClickSend, Vonage, Brevo or Plivo (WooCommerce → Settings → Shipping → Tracking → Text messages). Only to customers who ticked an unticked box at checkout (block checkout: additional field creative-tracking/sms-updates; classic: ctracking_sms_updates), with its words and time kept on the order (_ctracking_sms, removed by WooCommerce's privacy eraser). Texts for Shipped and Partially shipped (on) and, with live parcel status, Out for delivery, Delivered and Delivery problem (off): the shop's name, the order number, what happened and the tracking link, sent once each in the background (ctracking_sms_send), with an order note. A provider's opt-out reply stops later texts. A test text from the settings page. The provider is behind Sms\SmsGateway (filter ctracking_sms_gateway); its secret can be CTRACKING_SMS_TOKEN.
